versions.changelog: Bug fix: add_to_zotero_universal.sh fails closed on partial WebDAV config (URL-only setup no longer silently uploads to Zotero cloud); https:// validation now runs at startup before any Zotero API write; mode banner matches the actual upload branch condition; _meta.json version synced

Security fixes: delete_note.sh --backup now uses 0700 dir + 0600 files; add_to_zotero.sh/add_to_zotero_enhanced.sh fail fast in cloud mode instead of falsely claiming cloud upload (no such path existed - use add_to_zotero_universal.sh for cloud); docs reframed --no-confirm as risk note, corrected storage-mode claims
Security hardening: enforce https-only WebDAV URLs, allowlist Zotero hosts for API-key-bearing attachment downloads, unpredictable mktemp -d work dirs, zip-slip guard, filename path stripping

- Added support for new WebDAV environment variables: `ZOTERO_WEBDAV_URL`, `ZOTERO_WEBDAV_USER`, and `ZOTERO_WEBDAV_PASS` (was previously `WEBDAV_*`).
- Updated documentation to reflect the new `ZOTERO_WEBDAV_*` variable names and improved clarity.
- Improved WebDAV handling for add and read scripts for better cross-platform consistency.
- Removed deprecated legacy documentation file (`skill-card.md`).
- General cleanup and consistency improvements in scripts and metadata.

- Major reorganization of skill files: moved core scripts and documentation from subfolders to the root, with unused files removed.
- Added a LICENSE file for clearer legal guidance.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to reflect the new, streamlined file structure.
- No changes to core functionality or script parameters; usage remains the same.
- Improved clarity for setup, requirements, and available features.

Version 1.3.7 of zotero-enhanced brings a significant project reorganization and script improvements.

- All scripts and documentation are now under the dedicated skill directory (`skills/zotero-enhanced/`) for improved clarity and maintainability.
- Added SECURITY.md and a skill-specific SKILL.md for better documentation and security guidance.
- Improved and reorganized scripts for item/note management, reading, and metadata fetching.
- Removed the root-level `skill-card.md` in favor of a skill-specific version.
- No changes to end-user command usage or authentication requirements.
Fix script version alignment, help/version flags, filename sanitization, JSON payload quoting, note update HTML conversion, backup plaintext, and temp-file handling.
Fixed Chinese error text; enhanced HTML conversion (bold, lists, line breaks, entities)

zotero-enhanced v1.3.4

- Improved upload scripts (`add_to_zotero_enhanced.sh` and `add_to_zotero.sh`) to support both Zotero cloud and WebDAV storage (not limited to WebDAV only).
- Updated documentation to clarify that enhanced and basic upload scripts now work with both storage modes, not just WebDAV.
- No breaking changes to required variables or interfaces.

- Documentation updated for clarity, formatting, and completeness in SKILL.md.
- No functional or API changes; internal metadata remains the same.
- Improved structure for usage instructions and option explanations.
- Enhanced readability for onboarding and reference.

**v1.3.2 Changelog**

- Added explicit listing of external APIs/services used (Crossref, arXiv, Zotero API, WebDAV) in skill metadata
- No changes to core functionality; documentation and metadata update only
Fixed version conflict in Clawhub publication
Removed library organization tools (check_attachments.sh, find_duplicates.sh, analyze_tags.sh) per user request. Reverted documentation to focus on core metadata fetching and file management.

Added library organization tools: check_attachments.sh, find_duplicates.sh, analyze_tags.sh. All scripts include --dry-run safety and multiple output formats (text/json/csv). Enhanced documentation with new Library Organization Tools section. Improved error handling and pagination.
Added imported_url support for WebDAV-stored PDFs, implemented --dry-run mode for safe testing, improved argument parsing and help messages, updated security documentation.
Added security documentation (LICENSE, SECURITY.md), improved metadata with openclaw.requires, added --help/--version flags, moved env checks after argument parsing for better UX.
Cross-platform compatibility (Linux/macOS), added dependency checker, improved documentation. Universal scripts now detect platform-specific commands (md5sum/md5, stat options).
